description: blueteam.ee's GZCoord integration: the site's roles (brand-comms, with language-culture and edge-hosting beside it) are on the fleet's coordination channel, hosted by the relay on the coordinator's workspace — one fleet, one channel, whatever repository a session stands in. Read by gzcoord-inbox when the working copy resolves to project blueteam.ee; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL and GZCOORD_CHANNEL in the environment override it. No token_env_file: the account's token arrives with fabric-secrets sync (its own store), and a private site repository keeps no env file for it. relay_runtime_dir is relative to the workspace, never inside a repository. Written 2026-10-10, at registration.
